svg.title: Pottery card: isolate the pricing unit within practical details
svg.desc: Only the complete three-line pricing unit moves horizontally, from x65 to x360, preserving its baseline, words, scope, exclusion, internal spacing, fonts, sizes, weights and colors. All other elements and photographic presentation remain fixed. Local focal-point proposal, not a claim about first fixation. Fictional product card.
